# Security Policy

## Supported versions
| Version | Supported |
|---|---|
| latest (`main`) | yes |

## Reporting a vulnerability
Please **do not** open a public issue for a security vulnerability. Report it privately:

- Email **edy.cu@live.com**, or
- use GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/security-advisories/guidance-on-reporting-and-writing-information-about-vulnerabilities/privately-reporting-a-security-vulnerability) (Security, then Report a vulnerability).

SayAgain never sends anything to a plant and holds no credentials: the AMD Token Factory key is read from
`~/.config/amd-tokenfactory/env` and is never part of this repository.
